sql: SELECT s.id, s.created_at::date AS criado, s.name = 'reinforce_webhooks_service_key' AS nome_certo, s.name ~ '^eyJ' AS nome_eh_jwt, s.name IN ('SUA_CHAVE_AQUI', 'SUA_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_AQUI', 'OPENAI_API_KEY') AS nome_texto, s.decrypted_secret = 'reinforce_webhooks_service_key' AS valor_eh_texto_do_nome, s.decrypted_secret ~ '^eyJ' AS valor_eh_jwt, s.decrypted_secret ~ '^sk-' AS valor_parece_openai, length(s.decrypted_secret) AS tam_valor, CASE WHEN s.name ~ '^eyJ[^.]*\.[^.]+\.' THEN convert_from(decode(rpad(translate(split_part(s.name, '.', 2), '-_', '+/'), ((length(split_part(s.name, '.', 2)) + 3) / 4) * 4, '='), 'base64'), 'utf8')::json ->> 'role' END AS papel_no_nome, CASE WHEN s.decrypted_secret ~ '^eyJ[^.]*\.[^.]+\.' THEN convert_from(decode(rpad(translate(split_part(s.decrypted_secret, '.', 2), '-_', '+/'), ((length(split_part(s.decrypted_secret, '.', 2)) + 3) / 4) * 4, '='), 'base64'), 'utf8')::json ->> 'role' END AS papel_no_valor FROM vault.decrypted_secrets s ORDER BY s.created_at
